page.overview:
What is Venture?

The Venture is a highly advanced interstellar vessel used by the Coalition of Planets during their journeys to traverse the far reaches of space.

The Venture is a sleek, gray spaceship with a rounded body, lined with glowing blue lights and equipped with three large blue thrusters. It also has a smaller ship that can detach from the main vessel.
